title: Dune: Awakening patch 1.5.20.0 adds a fully offline single-player mode (Funcom)

sources.note: Funcom, Steam Community Announcements, 9 Nov 2026 12:35Z: patch 1.5.20.0 live on all platforms; single-player without an internet connection at any point, including creating and deleting characters; Go Online button; single-player server settings saved to the cloud; other fixes

footage.files: Steam Dune: Awakening Console and Single Player Launch Trailer (1920x960 inside 1080p, 2.0x)

claims.claim: single-player playable with no internet connection at any point, including creating and deleting characters
single-player server settings saved to the cloud

gate: gate 09:50Z: Funcom's own patch notes read in full on Steam; GamingOnLinux repeats it; no denial; 21 hours old at the slot

angle.hook: Dune: Awakening can now be played fully offline in single-player
angle.why_now: Funcom shipped patch 1.5.20.0 on 9 Nov after the console launch, and players had asked for it
angle.what_it_means_here: a Go Online button returns to the online world; settings follow the save across devices

story_items.update: change: offline single-player mode; demonstration: the Steam single-player launch trailer; effect on play: characters created and deleted offline, a Go Online button, settings in the cloud; availability: all platforms, patch 1.5.20.0

sensitive: none; the game's setting is science fiction, nothing religious in the wording
ledger_find: no offline-mode story; the 30 Oct Dune story is the Blood and Ice expansion
